types.description: Provisional generic normally open dry-contact level switch.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: The sole dry-contact pair 13/14 is universally required. Normal state is explicitly open at the authored reference condition; project process meaning must be stated by the author. Optional: none in this interface. Unmodeled: extra contacts, powered electronics, shields and bonding. Ratings, process setpoint, wetted materials and safety performance are unspecified. The author must select hardware and record actuation/reference level and ratings; 13/14 follows the existing core NO contact convention, not a manufacturer pinout.
